308)(g)1A/1295/1B/2020 IN CP/114/1B/2018
Ld. Counsel Ms. Pavithra Dayalan appears for the Applicant / Liquidator.
1A/1295/1B/2020 has been filed by the Liquidator seeking the following reliefs:
“ i) permit the Application to sell by way of private sale the immovable
property situated at Plot No.1F, Seventh Cross Street, Wood Creek
Country, Nandambakkam, Chennai standing in the name of Corporate
Debtor in Survey Nos.144 / 1B part and 144 / 2B part and situated at
Nandambakkam Village, Alandur Taluk, having land admeasuring 2,705
Sq. Ft. and building having built-up area of 5,525 Sq. Ft. within the
Sub-Registration District of Alandur within the Corporation limits of
Chennai and bearing Plot. No I in the approved layout known as
“Wood Creek County”); and
ii) pass other or further orders which may deem fit and thus render
Justice.”
This IA was filed on 01.12.2020 during the Covid lockdown period.
Pursuant to the orders passed by this Tribunal in IA/531(CHE)/2021 which was
pertaining to the scheme under Liquidation, this Application 1A/1295/1B/2020
was kept on hold.
We have dismissed IA/531(CHE)/2021 today.
As to the request made in IA/1295/IB/2020 to allow private sale of the property
of the Corporate Debtor, it is seen that this IA/1295/IB/2020 was filed during the
Covid lockdown. Much water has flown after that.
Ld. Liquidator is directed to issue suitable notice for public auction of the stated
property within a period of 15 days from the date of this order.
Accordingly, IA/1295/IB/2020 stands disposed off.

308)(i)IA/352(CHE)/2021 IN CP/114/1B/2018
Ld. Counsel Ms. Pavithra Dayalan is present for the Liquidator.
This Application has been filed seeking following reliefs:
A. To restrain the liquidator / Respondent from selling, transferring or
disposing off the assets of Corporate Debtor pending disposal of the scheme
of Arrangement proposed by the Applicant; and
B. To grant such other reliefs as the Hon’ble Tribunal may deem fit in the
interest of justice.
The Applicant herein was a scheme proponent for the company under liquidation.
1A/531(CHE)/2021 was filed seeking approval of the scheme under liquidation in
which it has been reported by Ld. Liquidator that SCC has already rejected the
scheme.
Today we have disposed off IA/531(CHE)/2021.
In view of the same, IA/352(CHE)/2021 stands disposed off.

308)(j)IA/531(CHE)/2021 IN 1A/352(CHE)/2021 IN CP/114/1B/2018
Ld. Counsel Ms. Pavithra Dayalan is present for the Liquidator.
1A/531(CHE)/2021 has been filed seeking following reliefs:
A. To direct the Liquidator to file the Scheme of Arrangement submitted by
the Applicant before this Hon'ble Tribunal for the consideration of this
Hon'ble Tribunal and take all such actions as may be necessary to process
such Scheme of Arrangement;
B. To stay the Private sale of the Assets of the Corporate Debtor by the
Liquidator pending sanction of the Scheme of Arrangement proposed by the
Applicant;
C. To stay all legal proceedings pending before this Hon'ble Tribunal in
relation to Corporate Debtor till such time the Scheme of Arrangement
proposed by the Applicant is considered and disposed off by this Hon'ble
Tribunal; and
D. To grant such other reliefs as the Hon'ble Tribunal may deem fit in the
interest of justice.
Submission of the Ld. Liquidator vide reply vide S.R.No.3312 dated
27.05.2022 at para 9 at page no.5 and the prayer are reproduced below:

“As SCC has rejected the Scheme and the Liquidator is awaiting the
approval of this Hon'ble Tribunal for the Private sale of the immovable
property (IA. No.1295 of 2021).”

“Therefore, it is humbly prayed that this Hon ble Tribunal may be pleased
to take on record the above Report of the Liquidator and approve the
private sale of the immovable property and pass order as it may deem fit
and appropriate and thus render justice.”

It is seen that the SCC has clearly rejected the scheme. Nothing survives in
1A/531(CHE)/2021. It is accordingly disposed off as infructuous.
